hero.headline: The {village} {commitment}

letter.joining: By signing this {commitment}, you are not just joining a community. You are becoming a co-creator of the most beautiful village we can imagine together. You are saying yes to regeneration, of the land, of community, of yourself.
letter.inReturn: In return, you become a full member of {entity}, gaining access to community spaces, governance participation, and the opportunity to deepen your involvement through roles, residency, or business creation.
letter.commitLead: As a member of {entity}, you commit to:

commitments.text: Treat all beings with respect, compassion, and authentic communication
Participate in community governance through our sociocratic circles
Contribute to the regeneration of the land and ecosystem
Support fellow community members in their growth and wellbeing
Honor the values and agreements of the {village} community
Practice Nonviolent Communication and authentic relating
Meet financial obligations as agreed with the community
Show up for community life, circles, celebrations, and shared care

thanks.quote: You are not just joining a place. You are becoming part of something alive.
